support_story_1_headline: Sɛ wɔn a wɔyɛ nneɛma kɔ so a, mpɔtam hɔfo tu anammɔn.
support_story_1_lead: Wo mfiri a wobɛbɔ ho ban afi hardware afiri a ɛyɛ komm ne nsakrae a asɛe ho.
support_story_1_body: Innioasis taa de firmwares foforo ma agodifo te sɛ Y1 (a ɛde n’ani si board nsakrae a ahintaw te sɛ 6.0, 7.0, ne 8.0) a ɛbubu mfiri dedaw no komm. Nea enye koraa no, wɔn wɛbsaet no ma kɔkɔbɔ zero ne zero kwan a wɔfa so kɔ firmwares a na ɛyɛ adwuma dedaw no so na ama wɔasan anya ahoɔden afi tebea a wɔde birikisi ayɛ mu. Updater ne Community Firmware adwuma no fa asinasin no: yɛkora agyapade stock ROM biara so, yɛhwɛ wo hardware nsakrae no mu ankasa, na yɛma wo player no yɛ adwuma dwoodwoo.
support_story_1_item_1: Rescuing Broken Players: Ahobammɔ nhwehwɛmu hwɛ hu sɛ updates foforo mfa birikisi hardware dedaw no da.
support_story_1_item_2: Archived Stock ROMs: Mfitiase adwumayɛbea firmwares a wɔaboaboa ano awie Innioasis a wɔapopa.
support_story_1_item_3: Native Cross-Platform: Nnwinnade a ɛhyerɛn a edi mũ ma macOS, Linux, ne Windows nyinaa.
support_story_1_item_4: Hardware Intelligence: Automatic board detection enti bere nyinaa wubenya package a ɛfata.
support_story_2_headline: Google Drives a asɛe biara nni hɔ. No guess-work biara nni hɔ. Firmware a ɛyɛ adwuma kɛkɛ.
support_story_2_lead: Mpɔtam hɔ nhyehyɛe a ɛkɔ ntɛmntɛm, a wɔagye atom a wubetumi de wo ho ato so ankasa.
support_story_2_body: Innioasis softwea a ɛyɛ aban de a wobɛhwehwɛ no taa kyerɛ sɛ wobɛhwehwɛ Google Drive link ahorow a ne bere atwam, Baidu mununkum mu kyɛfa a awu, ne ahintasɛm zip fael ahorow a nnwinnade a ɛhyerɛn biara nni nhyiam ahorow ase. Yɛkyekyeree download network a wotumi de ho to so, a ɛde ne ho a ɛwɔ SHA-256 mudi mu kura a wɔagye atom, update notifications, ne step-by-step guided installs. Wo ntoboa no sie tẽẽ de downloads ne hosting a ɛma eyi tumi yɛ yiye nnɔnhwerew 24 da biara, nnafua 365 afe biara.
support_story_2_item_1: Direct High-Speed ​​CDN: Nneɛma a wɔtwe ntɛmntɛm, tẽẽ a enni anohyeto biara a wɔde bɛtwe anaasɛ link a awu.
support_story_2_item_2: Update Notifications: Nya kɔkɔ bere a mpɔtam hɔfo foforo a wɔayi no adi anaasɛ wɔasiesie no akɔ fam no.
support_story_2_item_3: Guided Step-by-Step Installs: Nneɛma a wɔde aniwa hu a emu da hɔ no nantew wo wɔ bɔtn biara a wobɛmia mu.
support_story_2_item_4: Kasa Ahorow Mpɔtam: Wɔde Borɔfo, China, German, Spania, Franse & Japan kasa na ɛyɛ mpɔtam hɔfo koraa.
support_story_3_headline: Wo Innioasis player no tumi nyinaa a wobɛbue.
support_story_3_lead: Rockbox, dwumadie nhyehyɛeɛ a emu yɛ hare a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ, ne audiophile ahofadie a wɔde bɛba.
support_story_3_body: Stock factory software no twetwe nea wo Y1 anaa Y2 hardware betumi ayɛ no ani nkutoo. Yɛn mpɔtam hɔfo de Rockbox, custom operating systems a emu yɛ hare, audiophile codec playback, ne custom themes baa nkwa mu. Yɛtɔ honam fam hardware nsakraeɛ fi yɛn kotokuo mu de sɔ hwɛ, yɛyɛ reverse engineer, na yɛhwɛ sɛ instɔlehyɛn biara a ɛwɔ hɔ no yɛ nokware anaa. Supporting Updater tẽẽ de sika ma saa sɔhwɛ units yi na ɛma custom firmware nkɔso ntɛmntɛm.
support_story_3_item_1: Rockbox a Klik Baako: Audiophile a wɔbɔ ne nsɛmti a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ a wɔde ahyɛ mu wɔ sikɔne kakraa bi mu.
support_story_3_item_2: Community Firmware: Battery nkɔso, UI a ɛho tew, ne nnɛyi ɔdio codec mmoa.
support_story_3_item_3: Active Hardware Lab: Yɛsɔ hwɛ wɔ honam fam mfiri ankasa so ansa na yɛayi ɔdan biara adi.
support_story_3_item_4: Zero Bloatware: 100% free, kokoamsɛm-di kan software a enni dawurubɔ anaa tracking.
support_story_4_headline: Boa yɛn ma yɛnyɛ nea Innioasis nyɛ.
support_story_4_lead: Firmware a wɔkora so a mpɔtam hɔfo de di dwuma a ɛma wo mfiri nkɔ mmeae a wɔtow nneɛma gu.
support_story_4_body: Sɛ adwumakuw bi a wɔyɛ hardware kɔ wɔn mfiri a edi hɔ no so a, wogyae mfiri dedaw ahorow no. Innioasis mma Linux mmoa biara, nsakraeɛ ho nsɛm a ɛda adi pefee biara mma, na ɔkwan a ɛyɛ mmerɛw biara nni hɔ a wobɛfa so asan anya bio bere a instɔlehyɛn bi adi nkogu. Updater wɔ hɔ efisɛ ɛnsɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔn ani gye ho no tow nnwom a wɔbɔ no yiye koraa gu. Mpɔtam hɔfoɔ ntoboa 100% kɔ tẽẽ wɔ saa adwinnadeɛ yi a wɔbɛma wɔabue ama obiara no mu.
support_story_4_item_1: Rescue & Unbrick: Proven recovery flows mpo bere a mfiri pow sɛ wɔbɛbɔ.
support_story_4_item_2: Linux First-Class Support: MediaTek a ɛboa koraa a ɛrehyerɛn wɔ Linux distros so.
support_story_4_item_3: Transparent Changelogs: Nsɛm a wɔayi no adi a ɛkɔ akyiri sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wubehu nea ɛsakra no yiye.
support_story_4_item_4: 100% Community Funded: Kɔfe biara ma nneɛma a wɔkora so no bue na obiara nnye hwee.

err_sp_download_fail: Wotwaa nkyerɛwee mu. Hwɛ USB cable ne port ne battery charge, afei sɔ hwɛ bio.
err_sp_da_init_sync: Download agent no antumi amfi ase. Sɔ flash kwan foforo no hwɛ.
err_sp_brom_da_fail: Wɔantumi amfa download agent no ankɔ player no so. Dum no na san fa hyɛ mu bio.
err_sp_com_port: Adwinnade no antumi mmue ne serial port no. To nnwinnade afoforo a ɛhyerɛn mu na san fa hyɛ mu.
err_com_port_reboot_suggestion: Wɔantumi mmue USB COM port no (mfomso 1013). Sɛ wosan hyɛ wo kɔmputa no ase a, ɛbɛma port a wɔatoto mu no afi hɔ. Yɛsrɛ sɛ san hyɛ wo kɔmputa no ase na sɔ hwɛ bio.
err_sp_enable_dram: Adwinnade no antumi amfi agofomma no nkae ase. Fa package a wɔasi ama saa model pɛpɛɛpɛ yi di dwuma.
err_sp_storage_read: Adwinnade no antumi ankenkan player no storage. Hwɛ nkitahodi no; ebia afiri no wɔ hardware mfomso bi.
err_attempt_timeout: Adwinnade a ɛhyerɛn no ankyerɛ nkɔso biara wɔ {seconds} seconds mu, enti wogyaee mmɔdenbɔ yi.
err_connection_failed_desc: Antumi ne obi a ɔbɔ bɔɔl no nnya abusuabɔ a ɛyɛ den. Hwɛ sɛ woadum afiri no (fa pin bi mia reset button no so sɛ ɛho hia a), yi USB fi plug no mu, na san fa hyɛ mu bere a wɔabisa no.
err_flash_write_failed_desc: Wɔtwaa flashing mu anaasɛ write adwuma no dii nkogu. Hwɛ sɛ USB nhama no ahyɛ mu denneennen na battery no wɔ charge a ɛdɔɔso, afei sɔ hwɛ bio.
err_mtk_output_stall_title: Ɛte sɛ nea flash no akɔhyɛ mu
err_mtk_output_stall_desc: Adwinnade a ɛhyerɛn no ada nkyerɛwde koro no ara adi wɔ {seconds} sikani a etwa to no mu na ɛte sɛ nea ɛnkɔ so nkyerɛw firmware no. Ebia na flash no adi nkogu. Sɛ eyi yɛ mmɔdenbɔ abien a etwa to wɔ ɔkwan biara so wɔ nhyehyɛe bi a ebetumi asan akɔ wɔn ntam, anaasɛ sɛ MTKClient nkutoo na ɛwɔ saa afiri yi so a, san hyɛ kɔmputa no ase na sɔ hwɛ bio.
err_only_mtkclient_desc: MTKClient nko ara na ɛwɔ hɔ ma saa instɔlehyɛn yi. Ebia na flash no adi nkogu. Yɛsrɛ sɛ san hyɛ kɔmputa no ase na sɔ hwɛ bio.
err_mtk_output_stall_fallback_available: Saa kɔmputa yi nso betumi de SP Flash Tool ahyɛ mu. Sɛ wubetumi a, dan kɔ SP Flash Tool so na sɔ hwɛ bio.
prompt_restart_and_quit_title: San hyɛ wo kɔmputa no ase bio
prompt_restart_and_quit_desc: Ebia na flash no adi nkogu. Yɛsrɛ wo kenkan nkra a ɛwɔ atifi hɔ no na san hyɛ kɔmputa no ase ansa na woasan asɔ ahwɛ bio. Sɛ wobɔ OK a, app no ​​begyae sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wubetumi asan afi ase.
err_missing_package_files_desc: Firmware package no nni scatter fael anaa mfonini fael a wɔhwehwɛ no. Yɛsrɛ wo san twe package no anaa paw firmware fael a edi mũ.
err_tool_unavailable_title: Flashing Adwinnade a Ɛnyɛ Nea Ɛwɔ Hɔ
err_tool_unavailable_desc: Wɔantumi anhyɛ adwinnade a ɛhyerɛn anaa system draiver ahorow a wɔhwehwɛ no ase. Yɛsrɛ wo hwɛ system permissions, driver nhyehyɛe, anaa san instɔl application no.
err_driver_missing_title: MediaTek USB Draiver a Ɛho Hia
err_driver_missing_desc: Saa mfomso yi betumi aba bere a wɔanhyɛ MediaTek USB draiver no. Klik Download Drivers na fa MediaTek USB draiver no hyɛ mu, san hyɛ wo kɔmputa no ase, na sɔ hwɛ bio.
err_cache_file_missing_desc: Firmware fael bi a wɔde asie no nni hɔ. Paw Paw Software na san kyekye fael ahorow a wɔayiyi no anaa twe firmware archive no bio. Eyi yɛ mpɔtam hɔ fael haw, ɛnyɛ USB nkitahodi ho asɛm.
sel_cache_retry_tooltip: San kɔ Select Software na san kyekye anaa twe firmware package no.
sel_cache_retry_select_release: Paw firmware a wɔayi no adi a wobɛsan atwe bio.
err_generic_flash_failed_desc: Mfomsoɔ bi a wɔnhwɛ kwan sii wɔ instɔlehyɛn mu ({detail}). Dum player no koraa, san fa hyɛ mu bere a wɔaka akyerɛ no, na san bɔ mmɔden bio.
flash_attempt_timeout: Twɛn sɛ obi a ɔbɔ bɔɔl no... {seconds}s aka
flash_method_confirm: Install kwan a wɔasesa no ayɛ no {method}. Si so dua sɛ wɔayi player no fi plug no mu na wɔadum anyinam ahoɔden, afei klik Next so.
flash_failover_note: {method} antumi anhyɛ instɔlehyɛn no ase. Sɛ wɔdum player no anyinam ahoɔden na wɔayi afiri mu wie a, wɔde {other} bedi dwuma mmom.
themepack_card_title: Fa 360p Rockbox Asɛmti Pack no hyɛ mu
themepack_card_desc: Nea ɛka ho ne mpɔtam hɔ nsɛmti fɛfɛ, akyi mfonini a ɛyɛ fɛ, ne nkyerɛwde a wɔayɛ ama 360p nkyerɛkyerɛmu titiriw.
themepack_installed_success: ✓ 360p Theme Pack a wɔde ahyɛ mu yiye!
themepack_step1_title: Anamɔn 1: Fa nkitahodi wɔ USB Storage Mode mu
themepack_step1_desc:
1. Dane wo player no denam Power button a wobɛkura mu no so.
2. Sɛ Rockbox boot a, fa USB cable no hyɛ wo kɔmputa no mu.
3. Sɛ wobisa wɔ player screen no so a, si USB Storage mode no so dua sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a afiri no bɛda adi sɛ drive.
themepack_step2_title: Anamɔn 2: Paw Folda Biara a ɛwɔ Player no so
themepack_step2_desc: Esiane sɛ operating systems (te sɛ macOS) de dotfiles (te sɛ .rockbox) sie default nti, wubetumi apaw ANY folder anaa drive root wɔ wo player no so. Yɛbɛhunu anaa yɛbɛbɔ .rockbox directory no ama wo.
themepack_complete: Theme pack a wɔde ahyɛ mu yiye! Afei wubetumi atwa wo player no mu dwoodwoo na woapaw asɛmti bi wɔ Rockbox (Settings > Theme Settings).
themepack_err_not_found: Entumi nhwehwɛ anaasɛ entumi mfi ase .rockbox daerekta bi wɔ draibɛ a wɔapaw no so. Yɛsrɛ wo hwɛ hu sɛ woapaw folda bi wɔ wo player no so.
rockbox_wizard_skip_adb: Twa kɔ USB Storage Mode so
rockbox_wizard_reboot_title: Anamɔn 1: San hyɛ player no ase na san fa hyɛ mu bio
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc:
1. Twa USB nhama no mu.
2. Power player no san kɔ so na ma no boot nkɔ Rockbox mu.
3. Sɛ Rockbox no yɛ adwuma wie a, san fa USB nhama no hyɛ mu, afei mia Continue so.
rockbox_wizard_adb_title: Anamɔn 2: Hwehwɛ player no so ADB...
rockbox_wizard_adb_desc: App no ​​rehwɛ sɛ ADB nkitahodi bi wɔ hɔ (ɛkɔsi sikɔne 30). Sɛ wohu afiri bi a, wɔde asɛmti ahorow no kɔ baabi foforo na wɔsan bɔ player no bio. Sɛ ɛnte saa a, kɔ w’anim kɔ USB Storage Mode.
rockbox_wizard_adb_found: Mfiri a wɔahu ({serial}); asɛmti ahorow a wɔde kɔ baabi foforo...
rockbox_wizard_adb_timeout: ADB mfiri biara nni hɔ a wɔanhu wɔ sikɔne 30 mu; toa so de USB Storage Mode di dwuma.
rockbox_wizard_no_adb: ADB binary biara nni hɔ a ɛwɔ hɔ ma app no; toa so de USB Storage Mode di dwuma.
rockbox_wizard_adb_pushing: Asɛmti ne nkyerɛwde a wɔde piapia wɔ ADB so...
rockbox_wizard_adb_push_failed: ADB a wɔde kɔ baabi foforo no adi nkogu; a ɛsan kɔ USB Storage Mode so
rockbox_wizard_usb_title: Fa USB Storage Mode so fa so hyɛ mu
rockbox_wizard_usb_desc:
1. Ma USB Storage Mode nyɛ adwuma wɔ player no so sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a ɛbɛda adi sɛ drive.
2. Paw folda BIARA wɔ player a ɛwɔ ase ha no so (.rockbox, Nnwom, Themes, anaa drive root — .rockbox folda bi a ahintaw wɔ hɔ ankasa).
3. App no ​​ka 360p asɛmti ne nkyerɛwde no bom, na ɛkyerɛw fael ahorow a ɛwɔ din koro no so.
rockbox_wizard_done_title: 360p asɛmti & nkyerɛwde a wɔde ahyɛ mu!
rockbox_wizard_done_desc: Afei wubetumi atwa player no mu dwoodwoo na woapaw asɛmti bi wɔ Rockbox (Nsiesiei > Asɛmti Nsiesiei).
sel_local_rockbox_themes_option: Fa Rockbox 360p Nsɛmti + Fontpack no hyɛ mu
rockbox_stage_installing: Rockbox Themes & Fonts a wɔde ahyɛ mu...
rockbox_stage_pushing: Player a wɔahu. Mpɔtam hɔ nsɛmti & nkyerɛwde a wɔde besisi hɔ...
rockbox_stage_pushing_files_fmt: Asɛmti fael ahorow a wode besi hɔ ({curr} a ɛyɛ {total})...
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc_y1: Kura mfinimfini bɔtn no mu na fa wo Y1 no ahoɔden, san fa USB hyɛ mu, na paw USB Storage Mode.
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc_power: Kura power button no mu na ama wo player no anyinam ahoɔden, san fa USB no hyɛ mu, na paw USB Storage Mode.

rockbox_step2_connect_usb: Yɛsrɛ wo fa USB so fa wo {model} no hyɛ mu
rockbox_step_usb_storage_mode: Yɛsrɛ wo ma USB storage mode no nyɛ adwuma wɔ wo device no so na klik Next so
rockbox_step_select_player_folder: Yɛsrɛ sɛ paw player no ankasa anaa folda a ɛwɔ so no biako
rockbox_power_on_prompt_y1: Kura mfinimfini bɔtn no mu na fa wo Y1 no ahoɔden na fa USB no hyɛ mu.
rockbox_power_on_prompt_other: Kura power button no mu na fa wo {model} no ahoɔden na fa USB no hyɛ mu.
rockbox_ask_running_fmt: So Rockbox reyɛ adwuma wɔ wo {model} so?
rockbox_manual_guide:
1. Paw 'USB Storage Mode' wɔ wo player no so.
2. Klik 'Browse Folder...' na paw wo player na install themes.
rockbox_site_themes_note: Saa Rockbox dan yi de 240×320 asɛmti di dwuma, a wɔmfa nkabom. Nya asɛmti a wontua hwee ma wo player no fi Rockbox asɛmti site no so:
rockbox_troubleshoot_desc: Sɛ wo {model} no antumi ankɔ a, twa USB no mu, kura power button no mu 10s na woasan asiesie, na fa ahoɔden no hyɛ mu. Anaasɛ san fa mfitiase softwea no ba.
err_usb_lost_subtitle: So wobɛpɛ sɛ wosan sɔ hwɛ bio?
